instruction: Create a generic Node class for a circular linked list and demonstrate creating two nodes that reference each other.
Create programs that demonstrate various formatting options using WritelnFormat function, including reverse order output, escaping curly braces, field width specification, and decimal precision.
Create a record type with constructor and overridden ToString method that displays person information in a formatted string.
Create a program that demonstrates zero-based string indexing directive and its effect on string slices and indexing.
Create a program that finds real zeros of a function on isolation intervals using NumLibABC module.
Create programs that demonstrate Zip function usage for element-wise operations on sequences and Cartesian product operations.
Create a procedure that draws lines connecting all points of a regular polygon using Cartesian product.
Create programs that demonstrate different text alignment options in GraphWPF for both rectangle areas and point coordinates.
Create a WPF application with checkboxes that mix RGB colors to change the background color dynamically.
Create a WPF application with a combobox that displays standard colors and changes a rectangle's fill color when selected.
Create WPF applications that demonstrate DockPanel layout with buttons docked to different sides.
Create a WPF application that demonstrates dynamic font property changes including font size, font family, italic, and bold styles using sliders and checkboxes.
Create a WPF application that demonstrates dynamic rectangle property changes including width, height, and corner radius using sliders with data binding.
Create a program that demonstrates the Writeln procedure output for various data types including integers, strings, reals, sets, booleans, arrays, and tuples.
